plain: The earliest period of life or of anything new.

webster.text: The first part of life, beginning at the birth.

example.quote: Sir, I agree that it is not good policy to lay excises to any considerable amount, while our manufactures are in their infancy ; but are they always to be so ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, New York Convention, June 28, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
